title: The login page one word off
clue: Staff reported a sign-in page that was not the real portal. The operator scrambled their notes before uploading them. Submit the flag for how the accounts were actually taken.
evidence: whois         portal-login.test registered 2 days before the first email
idp           19 sign-ins from 192.0.2.61 with a valid one-time code; 0 push prompts sent
hints: Two layers. The outer one uses a 64-character alphabet.
Under it is hex of keyed bytes, so a plain hex decode looks like noise. The kit's config has two secrets; only one is for notes.
What the lure claimed isn't the method, and push prompts were never sent.
